<!--
  An account settings form: a picture with a change button, name, email, bio and two notification switches, with
  save and cancel. Axes: layout (stacked, split), avatar (show, hide), prefs (show, hide), tone (default,
  muted).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { ProfileLabels } from "./profile-form.types";

  export type ProfileFormProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    labels: ProfileLabels;
    layout?: "stacked" | "split";
    avatar?: "show" | "hide";
    prefs?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Form from "../primitives/form/form.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Input from "../primitives/input/input.svelte";
  import Label from "../primitives/label/label.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Switch from "../primitives/switch/switch.svelte";
  import Textarea from "../primitives/textarea/textarea.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import Field from "../components/field.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import Panel from "../components/panel.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    labels,
    layout = "stacked",
    avatar = "show",
    prefs = "show",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ProfileFormProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : ((title && id) ? tpl("{0}-t", id) : undefined))}
  data-testid="panel-section"
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4 py-8" data-slot="container">
    <Panel title={title} description={text} id={id} class={cn((((tone as string) === "muted") ? "bg-muted" : ""))}>
      <Form method="dialog" class="gap-6" data-testid="profile-form">
        <Grid cols={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "1-2" : "1")} class="items-start gap-8">
          <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
            {#if ((avatar as string) === "show")}
              <Group gap="4" align="center" data-testid="avatar">
                <MediaFrame alt={labels.picture} ratio="1/1" class="size-16 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" type="button">
                  {labels.change}
                </Button>
              </Group>
            {/if}
            <Field label={labels.name} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-name", id)}>
              <Input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" id={tpl("{0}-name", id)} data-testid="field" />
            </Field>
            <Field label={labels.email} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-email", id)}>
              <Input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" id={tpl("{0}-email", id)} data-testid="field" />
            </Field>
            <Field label={labels.bio} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-bio", id)}>
              <Textarea rows={4} name="bio" id={tpl("{0}-bio", id)} data-testid="field" />
            </Field>
          </Stack>
          {#if ((prefs as string) === "show")}
            <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="prefs">
              <Title as={3} size="base" weight="bold">
                {labels.prefs}
              </Title>
              <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between">
                <Label for={tpl("{0}-updates", id)} class="text-sm">
                  {labels.updates}
                </Label>
                <Switch name="updates" id={tpl("{0}-updates", id)} />
              </Group>
              <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between">
                <Label for={tpl("{0}-alerts", id)} class="text-sm">
                  {labels.alerts}
                </Label>
                <Switch name="alerts" id={tpl("{0}-alerts", id)} />
              </Group>
            </Stack>
          {/if}
        </Grid>
        <Group gap="2" class="flex-wrap">
          <Button variant="default" size="default" type="submit" data-testid="submit">
            {labels.save}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button">
            {labels.cancel}
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Form>
    </Panel>
  </Container>
</Block>
